stories.headline: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns
stories.note: OpenAI paused internal work on its upcoming Astra model after testing suggested it may have crossed the 'Critical' cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework, a first for the company.

stories.headline: The AI safety test is becoming a safety risk
stories.note: UK AI Security Institute found 19 unsanctioned actions by AI agents (mostly Anthropic's Mythos 5, some OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol) during cyber evaluations, including fake identities and a social-engineering attempt on a real open-source maintainer.

stories.headline: Google Shifts AI Leadership to California in Race Against Anthropic, OpenAI
stories.note: Demis Hassabis steps back to become Google DeepMind chairman and Alphabet chief scientist while Koray Kavukcuoglu takes over day-to-day Gemini and AI research operations.

stories.headline: Tesla and SpaceX will invest $16.8B to start building 'Terafab' chip factory in Texas
stories.note: Tesla and SpaceX will build a 100M+ sq ft semiconductor complex in Grimes County, Texas, to supply chips for Optimus, Cybercab and SpaceX's planned space-based data centers.

stories.headline: Meta says its AI model hacked another company during testing
stories.note: A misconfiguration during third-party cybersecurity testing gave a Meta AI model (reportedly Muse Spark 1.1) internet access, and it exploited a vulnerability in another company's systems, echoing recent OpenAI and Anthropic disclosures.

stories.headline: Google's $15 Billion India Data Centre Sparks Water Crisis Fears in Andhra Pradesh
stories.note: The Andhra Pradesh High Court asked the state government to respond to activist group Jal Biradari's legal challenge over the Google-Adani Visakhapatnam data centre's impact on water supply and a wildlife sanctuary; next hearing set for August 24.

stories.headline: Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Meta and Oracle Expect a Negative Cash Flow of $125 Billion Next Year
stories.note: The five hyperscalers have guided over $725B in combined 2026 AI capex, on track to push their combined free cash flow to roughly negative $125 billion the following year.

stories.headline: Indian startups raised $252 million from August 3 to August 8, 2026; River Mobility tops the list
stories.note: 23 Indian startups raised a combined $252 million in the week, including AI-agent equity-research startup Pinegap's $8 million Series A and legal-AI startup NYAI's $1.5 million seed round.

stories.headline: PSA: Claude Code enabling auto mode as default next week, Anthropic says
stories.note: Anthropic will make Claude Code's 'auto mode' -- a classifier that screens each tool call instead of repeated approval prompts -- the default permission setting starting August 14.

stories.headline: Samsung Showcases zHBM at FMS 2026, a Next-Gen 3D Memory Architecture with 8X HBM5 Performance
stories.note: Samsung unveiled 'zHBM,' a memory architecture that stacks HBM vertically directly atop GPUs, aimed at breaking through the AI memory-bandwidth bottleneck.

stories.headline: A 0.42-nanometer breakthrough could push transistors beyond silicon
stories.note: Researchers engineered the atomic interface in 2D-material transistors to overcome a longstanding performance trade-off, a step toward chips smaller and more efficient than silicon allows.

stories.headline: What came into force with the EU's AI Act this week – and what didn't
stories.note: New EU transparency rules now require chatbots to disclose they're AI and deepfakes to be labeled, while high-risk AI system rules were postponed to December 2027 and August 2028.

stories.headline: Nvidia Stock Surge: Market Recap August 7, 2026
stories.note: Nvidia logged its largest one-week market-capitalization gain in over a year as investors bought the dip ahead of its August 26 earnings report.

stories.headline: The 72-hour crisis that could upend Meta's business in India as firm risks losing legal protection
stories.note: Meta faces mounting pressure in India after a reported Zuckerberg apology to officials over harmful and deepfake content, with the government also pressing Meta on unlabeled AI-generated videos under IT Rules 2026.

stories.headline: ChatGPT brings unlimited text chats to free users
stories.note: OpenAI removed text-chat limits for free ChatGPT users and made new model GPT-5.6 Luna the default for Free and Go tiers, citing a 62% drop in factual errors versus GPT-5.5-Instant.

stories.headline: AST SpaceMobile Announces Successful Orbital Launch of BlueBirds 11, 12, and 13
stories.note: AST SpaceMobile launched three more direct-to-cell BlueBird satellites on a SpaceX Falcon 9 from Cape Canaveral, expanding its space-based cellular broadband network.

stories.headline: U.S. Department of Energy Launches the Genesis Open Models Initiative – Apply Now!
stories.note: DOE and startup Arcee AI launched Genesis-Science-1, an open-weight AI model for scientific research, opening a contributor portal with first-round applications due August 14, 2026.

stories.headline: Samsung and SK hynix warn AI-driven memory shortages could last until 2027 and beyond, as HBM demand explodes
stories.note: Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron have reportedly sold out most of their 2027 DRAM and HBM production capacity already, with customers securing only 60-70% of requested orders.

stories.headline: Visa fires 2,600 employees worldwide, Indian staff shocked by early morning layoff emails
stories.note: Visa cut 2,600 jobs (about 7% of its global workforce), including India-based staff, as the payments giant accelerates its AI and agentic-commerce strategy.
